description: CNA::Diagnostics: a bounded recording, resources following their handles and the instrumentation macros, each as the compile-time level promises (FULL, STATS or OFF)
expectRegex: \[museum\]\[diagnostics\] overflow: (StartRecording\(16\) kept [0-9]+ events and reports [1-9][0-9]* dropped|not attempted, runtime level (Off|Stats))
pl-diagnostics CNA_DIAGNOSTICS_GAUGE_SET 40 then GAUGE_ADD 2 at level [0-2]: PASS
pl-diagnostics CNA_DIAGNOSTICS_FRAME_COUNTER_ADD registers a per-frame counter at level [0-2]: PASS
pl-diagnostics (CNA_PROFILE_SCOPE\("Museum/MacroScope"\) in the trace at level [1-2]: PASS|CNA_PROFILE_SCOPE and CNA_DIAGNOSTICS_EVENT: SKIP \(they reach a trace only at runtime level Full)
pl-diagnostics (CNA_DIAGNOSTICS_EVENT\("Museum/MacroEvent"\) in the trace at level [1-2]: PASS|CNA_PROFILE_SCOPE and CNA_DIAGNOSTICS_EVENT: SKIP)
\[museum\]\[diagnostics\] re-registration: (after Reset the resource is gone; registered again it is listed|diagnostics are compiled out \(CNA_DIAGNOSTICS=OFF\), nothing is tracked)
